params.name: widget
params.description: Filter stats by a specific widget. For example "1234". Defaults to all widgets.

params.name: domain
params.description: Filter widgets by a specific domain. For example "revcontent.com". Defaults to all domains.

params.name: device
params.description: Filter stats by a specific device. Values: "all", "desktop", "tablet", "mobile", "unknown". Defaults to all.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Start date for the statistics in Y-m-d format. Defaults to first of the current month.

params.name: date_to
params.description: End date for the statistics in Y-m-d format. Defaults to today.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records to return. Max 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for the records to return.

params.name: aggregate
params.description: If 'yes', statistics aggregated by date are retrieved.

params.name: country
params.description: Filter stats by a specific country. Values: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, for example "US", or "unknown". Defaults to all countries.
